Name: Monster Compass
Author: iamBLAZEfr
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Monster Compass puts glowing arrows around your character that point to the monsters on your floor. It helps you find monsters on big floors, infested floors and dark floors, in Skull Cavern and in the Volcano, including crabs that hide as stones. The closest monster gets a big arrow, so you always know where to go next. Everything is drawn in code, so there are no extra files to install.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
1. Install the latest version of SMAPI.
2. Download the mod and unzip it.
3. Put the MonsterCompass folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
4. Launch the game through SMAPI.
5. Go into the mines. The arrows show up on their own when there are monsters on the floor.

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Big arrow for the closest monster: It shows the monster's real name and how far away it is, like "Mummy - 12 tiles".[/*]
[*]Smart arrow sizes: The 2nd and 3rd closest monsters get medium arrows with their names. All other monsters get small arrows that get fainter the farther away they are.[/*]
[*]Arrows that make sense: Arrows stay even when the monster is on your screen. They fade out when you get close and vanish when the monster dies.[/*]
[*]Real monster names: Mummy, Serpent, Squid Kid, Ghost, Frost Bat and more, taken from the game.[/*]
[*][b][u]Color codes by monster family:[/u][/b][/*]
[/list][list=1]
[*]Green: slimes[/*]
[*]Purple: bats[/*]
[*]Orange: crabs (they can hide as stones)[/*]
[*]Yellow: bugs, grubs and flies[/*]
[*]Sand: mummies[/*]
[*]Teal: serpents[/*]
[*]Blue: squid kids[/*]
[*]Pale cyan: ghosts[/*]
[*]Bone white: skeletons[/*]
[*]Pink: shadow monsters[/*]
[*]Brown: dust spirits and duggies[/*]
[*]Fire orange: lava, magma and hot monsters[/*]
[*]Red: all other monsters[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 or newer[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0 or newer[/*]
[*]No other mods are required.[/*]
[*]Compatibility: The mod only draws on the screen and does not change monsters or maps. It should work with other mods, but I have not tested all of them.[/*]
[/list]
